title: Timepoint 2 — Weekly outpatient drainage near home
scenarioBrief: Now we jump ahead about six weeks. Since her ED visit, Ms. Whitlock has been having weekly outpatient drainage procedures at a radiology facility near her home, and she was seen by hepatology last week. You are reviewing her chart today (4/22/2027). The chart is updated with the interval records. Please review the chart and answer the question below.

chartGate._notes: TP2 visibility: TP1 records PLUS the community-radiology weekly procedure note (3/24; documents 4 units FFP + albumin with every session for INR 2.0) and the 4/15 hepatology telehealth note. The outside-hospital ICU admission (4/28–4/30) is NOT visible yet: Q2B asks the resident to weigh the FFP practice BEFORE the complication is revealed (Kevin, 17 Sep 2026).

prompts.question: During each outpatient procedure she is now receiving 4 units of FFP because of her elevated INR. What are the possible risks and benefits of giving FFP in this patient?

scoringRubric.rubricText:
Total 4 points.
- Recognizes there are NO benefits to giving FFP here: 1 point
- Three of the five of the following risks: 3 points
  - Portal hypertension (volume/pressure)
  - Transfusion reaction
  - Transfusion-related infection
  - Transfusion-associated lung injury (TRALI)
  - Waste of blood products
APPLICABLE MAXIMUM: 4.
